blocks.text: Advantages of our modern wooden yurt models

segs.t: The advantages of Yourteco yurts for tourism professionals: peace of mind guaranteed! For tourism providers, choosing exceptional accommodation is a strategic investment. With Yourteco yurts, you’re opting for reliability and performance : two essential qualities that ensure lasting peace and security.

blocks.text: Durability and resilience in all conditions

segs.t: Our yurts are designed for intensive use and built to withstand diverse climate conditions around the world.

items.t: we use treated wood for the structural frame, high-density technical fabrics (PVC-coated polyester, treated cotton canvas, etc.), and high-performance insulation materials to ensure exceptional longevity. Each yurt is made to last season after season, helping you minimize replacement and maintenance costs.
every yurt is engineered to resist strong winds, heavy rain, and snow loads. Our structures are calculated to provide maximum stability and safety for both your guests and your staff.
the selected materials allow for quick and easy cleaning — a major advantage for the daily management of your accommodation site and the optimization of your occupancy cycles.

segs.t: The safety of your guests is our top priority. Our yurts are designed and manufactured according to the strictest standards.

items.t: our production processes include rigorous quality controls. On request, we can provide technical data sheets for the materials to help you meet local accommodation regulations.
the fabrics we use can be treated to be flame-retardant — a crucial feature for fire protection in publicly accessible facilities.

by offering distinctive accommodation, you enhance your establishment’s image and stand out from the competition.
our team advises you in selecting the models best suited to your project, optimizing spatial design, and assessing profitability — giving you a clear vision of your investment.

segs.t: We understand the challenges of export and provide you with comprehensive assistance.

items.t: we handle the entire logistics chain — from secure packaging and international shipping to customs clearance. You don’t have to worry about the complexities of import procedures.
whether through detailed manuals, video tutorials, or the help of our teams and local partners, we ensure a smooth and efficient installation of your yurts, wherever you are.
our team is available to answer all your questions or provide spare parts, ensuring the long-term durability of your installation.

segs.t: With Yourteco, you’re investing in a reliable, safe, and profitable accommodation solution designed to support the success of your tourism business.
